rooms.name: The Great Hall
rooms.description: You stand in a vast stone hall. Faded tapestries line the walls, depicting scenes of forgotten battles. A grand staircase spirals upward, and a heavy iron door is set into the floor. Passages lead north and west.

exits.description: A heavy iron door is set into the floor. It is locked.

rooms.name: The Garden
rooms.description: A walled garden, overgrown but still beautiful. Wildflowers push through cracked flagstones, and ivy climbs the ancient walls. The Great Hall lies to the east.

rooms.name: The Library
rooms.description: Floor-to-ceiling bookshelves crowd this dusty room. Most of the books have crumbled to dust, but a few leather-bound volumes remain. A curious alcove is set into the far wall. The Great Hall is to the south.

rooms.name: The Tower Room
rooms.description: A circular room at the top of the spiral staircase. Wind whistles through narrow arrow slits. An ornate wooden chest sits against the wall. Stairs lead back down.

rooms.name: The Cellar
rooms.description: A cold, damp cellar beneath the Great Hall. Water drips from the low ceiling. In the center of the room, a stone pedestal rises from the floor, covered in strange runes. Stairs lead back up.

items.name: brass lantern
items.description: A sturdy brass lantern. It casts a warm, steady glow.

items.name: old book
items.description: A crumbling leather-bound book. The only legible passage reads: "...and the amulet shall rest upon the pedestal, and the way shall be opened..."

items.name: rusty key
items.description: A rusty iron key, cold to the touch. It looks like it might fit a heavy lock.

items.name: wooden chest
items.description: An ornate wooden chest with iron bindings. It is closed.

items.name: gold amulet
items.description: A gleaming gold amulet on a fine chain. Strange runes are etched into its surface, matching those on a pedestal somewhere below.

items.name: stone pedestal
items.description: A waist-high stone pedestal covered in ancient runes. There is a shallow, circular depression on its top surface — just the right size for an amulet.

npcs.name: old gardener
npcs.description: A weathered old man in dirt-stained clothes, tending to the wildflowers with surprising care.
dialogue: "Ah, a visitor! Haven't seen one in ages," the gardener says, looking up from his work. "If you're looking for secrets, the library might reward a careful eye. Check the alcove — things aren't always as they seem."
"Still here? Well, I've said all I know. The library alcove, remember? Give it a good look."
The gardener hums quietly and returns to his flowers.
